title: the Nonhumans' Deities
audit_comment: THE NONHUMANS' DEITIES - the D&DG walk round sixteen, print pp. 105-112: twenty stat-block rows - the six greater gods (Moradin the Soul Forger, Corellon Larethian, Maglubiyet, Garl Glittergold, Yondalla, Gruumsh), the twelve lesser (Hruggek, Skerrit the Forester, Deep Sashelas, Lolth, Rillifane Rallathil, Grolantor, Skoraeus Stonebones, Kurtulmak, Blibdoolpoolp, Semuanya, Eadro, Sekolah) and the two demigods (Vaprak, Laogzed) - plus the shaman and witch doctor doctrine of the intro (the 1-4 hit point ladder, the 2-5 tandem bonus, the per-two-levels hit dice improvement, the gnoll/goblin/orc examples, the thirteen-being NOTE list of MM and FF lesser gods) and the section-wide shaman level caps (3rd to 14th) riding as consts, with the cross-reference roster as the round's data file. THE HEADLINE ADJUDICATIONS: the MORADIN-CORELLON FOLD SWAP - the psm-4 extract interleave gave Moradin the S:21(+4,+9) I:25 W:25 D:25 C:21 CH:25 line and Corellon the S:25(+7,+14) I:23 W:20 D:21 C:25 CH:19(25 to dwarves) line; the tsv x-coordinates settle both (the x=1306 right-column line is Corellon, the x=398 left-column line is Moradin) and the damage riders corroborate (Moradin 4-40 (+14), Corellon 3-30 (+9)) - the R857 Ra/Anhur geometry-swap precedent. The KURTULMAK-BLIBDOOLPOOLP TAIL SWAP: the same fold swapped the thief/psionic/ability tails; geometry gives Kurtulmak the 12th assassin, the VI pipe and S:22(+4,+10) I:19 W:9 D:19 C:19 CH:19, and Blibdoolpoolp the 15th assassin, the III print and S:21(+4,+9) I:20 W:10 D:21 C:23 CH:11 - the L&L transcription agrees on every cell. THE NOT-PRINTED DEX: Hruggek ability line has no dex cell - the tsv geometry shows only the bare 36px inter-cell gap between W:8 and C:24, and the L&L marks the same gap; pinned 0. THE FRACTION SIZES (the R859 fingerprint): Yondalla prints the 4 1/2 foot cell (the tesseract 42 inches, the L&L 4.5 feet) pinned 54; Kurtulmak the 5 1/2 foot (the tesseract 5 percent glyph) pinned 66. THE DIVERGENT CELLS pinned by the 2nd print with the L&L noted: Sashelas D:21 (L&L 18), Vaprak W:12 (L&L 18 - eyeball flag, the tesseract conf 90), Lolth MR 70 (L&L 75), Lolth psionic See below with the discipline prose (the L&L block prints 266 with all modes - a later-print or transcription gloss), Blibdoolpoolp MU 20th magic-user (L&L illusionist), Laogzed harmful spells (L&L destructive), and the Nine Hells planes of Maglubiyet, Kurtulmak, Gruumsh and Sekolah (the L&L Gehenna and Acheron and Stygia glosses are the transcriber D64 annotations, not print ink). THE LOLTH SPIDER PRINT: the AC -10 with the drow-form paren (the tesseract +2 misread at conf 53, the L&L -2, the game-sense tiebreak - the paren is an armor class and a plus-signed cell is not legal notation - eyeball flag), the MOVE 1 inch / 9 inch web walk of the MM giant spider convention (the tesseract 17 misread) with the drow-form 15 riding a const, the 66 hit points, and the See below 99 pairs on both class lines (the egp Isis precedent) with the 16th cleric / 14th magic-user drow form riding consts. The psionic pipes: I Corellon, Rillifane, Sekolah; II Semuanya, Eadro (the tsv I/ and Il misreads, both corroborated by the L&L); III Sashelas, Blibdoolpoolp; V Skerrit, Gruumsh; VI Moradin, Grolantor, Skoraeus, Maglubiyet, Kurtulmak, Vaprak. The As 16+ HD monster fighter cells (twelve) pin 16 with the as-monster-HD reading noted in the col comment. ZERO registry defs touched - the floor holds at 995.

banner.title: the Nonhumans' Deities - the D&DG walk round sixteen, print pp. 105-112: twenty stat-block rows - the six greater gods (Moradin, Corellon Larethian, Maglubiyet, Garl Glittergold, Yondalla, Gruumsh), the twelve lesser (Hruggek, Skerrit, Deep Sashelas, Lolth, Rillifane Rallathil, Grolantor, Skoraeus Stonebones, Kurtulmak, Blibdoolpoolp, Semuanya, Eadro, Sekolah) and the two demigods (Vaprak, Laogzed) - plus the shaman doctrine and the NOTE list of the intro.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (commit cd645b4, pNNN_full.txt + pNNN_tsv.tsv, print = pdf - 1, pages 106-113; the second printing) with the tsv x-y geometry as the fold-swap and not-printed-cell arbiter; the collation voice: the 1eonline L&L transcription (the R853 parity voice). The adjudications: the Moradin-Corellon and Kurtulmak-Blibdoolpoolp fold swaps, the Hruggek dex gap, the Yondalla and Kurtulmak fraction sizes, the Lolth 1/9 web walk and the -2 drow paren, the Vaprak W 12 and Sashelas D 21 divergences, and the Nine Hells plane pins against the L&L D64 glosses.

data_files.content:
DDG Nonhumans' Deities cross references (print pp. 105-112,
the 2nd printing). The NOTE list of beings treated as lesser gods
though they very rarely have human worshipers, plus the section's
walk-forward worship pointers (all detailed in the MONSTER MANUAL
or FIEND FOLIO except Lolth, whose stat block rides this section).

MONSTER MANUAL lesser gods (the NOTE list)
  Demon:   Demogorgon, Juiblex, Orcus, Yeenoghu
  Devil:   Asmodeus, Baalzebul, Dispater, Geryon
  Dragon:  Bahamut, Tiamat

FIEND FOLIO lesser gods (the NOTE list)
  Demon:   Lolth (detailed in this volume)
  Elemental Princes of Evil (unnamed here)
  Slaad:   Ssendam, Ygorl

Worship pointers of the section (race -> deity, shaman/cleric cap)
  bugbears      -> Hruggek (5th)
  centaurs      -> Skerrit (3rd); satyrs too, but no clerical members
  dwarves       -> Moradin (NPC clerics 7th)
  elves         -> Corellon Larethian (NPC clerics 7th)
  elves, aquatic-> Deep Sashelas (clerics 7th)
  elves, drow   -> Lolth (female WIS 18 clerics to 14th)
  elves, wood   -> Rillifane Rallathil (clerics of both cults 7th)
  ettins        -> Grolantor (3rd, the two-headed aspect)
  giants, fire  -> Surtur (7th; the cured steel head talisman)
  giants, frost -> Thrym (7th; the frozen sacrifices)
  giants, hill  -> Grolantor (7th)
  giants, stone -> Skoraeus Stonebones (7th)
  gnolls        -> Yeenoghu (5th, the triple flail)
  gnomes        -> Garl Glittergold (NPC clerics 7th)
  goblins       -> Maglubiyet (7th)
  halflings     -> Yondalla (NPC clerics 5th)
  hobgoblins    -> Maglubiyet (7th, see GOBLINS)
  ixitxachitl   -> Demogorgon (8th)
  kobolds       -> Kurtulmak (5th)
  kuo-toa       -> Blibdoolpoolp (clerics 12th)
  lizard men    -> Semuanya (7th)
  locathah      -> Eadro (shamans 3rd)
  mermen        -> Eadro (clerics 5th)
  ogres, trolls -> Vaprak (3rd)
  orcs          -> Gruumsh (5th; pluck the left eye)
  sahuagin      -> Sekolah (5th)
  troglodytes   -> Laogzed (3rd)
